verdict.rationale: Orrick offers software-delivered tools: Tech Studio's web-based document generators and interactive forms, plus Orrick Labs legal technology. A CLI is therefore a fair axis for this product, but nothing in the evidence documents an official command-line interface. The interactive forms are browser-based and require cookies to load, and the llms.txt probe returned a 404, so there is no programmatic or agent-facing surface in evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
